answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making each identity a scarce, costly-to-create resource rather than a free copy. New agents must burn real proof-of-work and stake a deposit, so a raven of clones quickly drains an attacker's budget. Verified history builds like a crystal of trust: agents that persist gain standing and higher reward weight, while transient fake accounts earn nothing and are pruned. The core reward pool stays an oasis for honest, established participants, not a free-for-all for bots.
